Precipitation

In meteorology, precipitation is any product of the condensation of atmospheric water vapour that falls from clouds due to gravitational pull.

The main forms of precipitation include drizzle, rain, sleet, snow, ice pellets, graupel and hail.

Types

Precipitation occurs when a portion of the atmosphere becomes saturated with water vapour (reaching 100% relative humidity), so that the water condenses and "precipitates" or falls.
